researchDepth: Eight-Driver bounded landscape, existing-edge and source-alignment audit with task/measurement, replication and comparator checks. Not a formal systematic review per Driver. Selected-source access depth explicit; no candidate quota.

entityReviews.constructReview: Proportion of available attention allocated to a specified target; not attention capacity or total task duration.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Dwell-time proportion requires an explicit denominator and relevant region/window; fixation count, first-fixation latency and covert allocation are different measures.
entityReviews.timeReview: Seconds/minutes within a specified display/task, not enduring attention ability.
entityReviews.unresolved: Cueing and social/cultural viewing effects are promising but no exact proportion contrast extracted; no signed whole-attention effect.

entityReviews.constructReview: Psychological prominence/capture priority, not objective visual contrast or the emotional intensity of content.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Orienting latency, gaze capture and prominence ratings need separate operational alignment; salient is not necessarily attended voluntarily.
entityReviews.timeReview: Momentary priority conditional on goals, task and competing stimuli.
entityReviews.unresolved: Emotional-content→salience sources do not supply exact manipulation/priority evidence; source misinformation/dehumanization findings cannot substitute.

entityReviews.constructReview: Occupied limited processing resources under a task and concurrent operations; not objective difficulty itself.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Mental-effort, perceived-difficulty and NASA-TLX composites are not interchangeable measures. Shared resource definitions with available WM can create conceptual inverse dependence.
entityReviews.timeReview: During-task occupancy separated from retrospective ratings, chronic fatigue and learning outcomes.
entityReviews.unresolved: Cueing load claim retained RESEARCH_NEEDED because synthesis combines perceived effort/difficulty. Existing BIO/INF revision paths linked, never repaired.

entityReviews.constructReview: Currently available maintenance/manipulation resources; not a stable trait capacity or score on one practiced task.
entityReviews.measurementReview: N-back, span and transfer accuracy depend on strategy, skill and stimulus domain. Improved trained score does not uniquely identify greater available resources.
entityReviews.timeReview: Training transfer/durability and momentary availability are separate; sleep/fatigue timing preserved.
entityReviews.unresolved: N-back practice effect remains research-needed/UNKNOWN on exact Driver; task-specific transfer and active-control nulls preserved.

entityReviews.constructReview: Effortful issue-relevant processing, not any slow response, recall score or reflective-test success.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Thought listing can index relevant processing but amount, valence and quality differ; font difficulty manipulates presentation not elaboration directly.
entityReviews.timeReview: Within message/task, contingent on relevance, ability and motivation; no enduring change in need for cognition.
entityReviews.unresolved: Replicated failure of font→CRT benefit blocks inferring deeper elaboration from slowness. No new duplicate of REL-PSY-007/030.

entityReviews.constructReview: Nominal categorical active construal frame, not an ordinal quantity or a valenced amount.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Gain/loss wording is external content; an internally adopted frame needs a qualified category and a valid manipulation check, not choice alone.
entityReviews.timeReview: Task-specific adoption and replacement, not one construct transforming into another.
entityReviews.unresolved: No LEVEL/INCREASE claim on a nominal frame. Category-specific state representation requires an exact scoped proposal; no architecture change inferred merely from a lack of evidence.

entityReviews.constructReview: Experienced ease of perceiving/retrieving/thinking; not reading speed, factual accuracy, familiarity or confidence itself.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Objective font readability/response time needs subjective-ease alignment; ease attribution and prior expectations can reverse interpretation.
entityReviews.timeReview: Trial/message-specific processing and later judgment must be temporally distinguished.
entityReviews.unresolved: SRC171 title/year and PMID disagree; its URL duplicates SRC125. No independent replication counted or canonical correction made.

entityReviews.constructReview: Available ability to shift perspective, rule or strategy; not psychological acceptance/flexibility or intelligence.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Switch-cost latency, shifting accuracy, perseveration and self-report are task-dependent; speed/accuracy effects cannot be pooled as one latent capacity.
entityReviews.timeReview: Short task state versus acquired transferable skill over weeks/months requires durability and transfer evidence.
entityReviews.unresolved: Mindfulness reviews disagree by comparator and outcome; accuracy benefits and latency nondetection do not establish uniform cognitive-flexibility change.

hypotheses.question: Cognitive load is simply task difficulty.
hypotheses.reason: Demand, expertise and experienced/occupied resources differ.

hypotheses.question: Adding instructional cues decreases PSY-057.
hypotheses.reason: Meta-analysis pools effort and difficulty scales; EA-0010 preserves proxy gap.

hypotheses.question: Instructional visual cues increase PSY-055 target-allocation proportion.
hypotheses.reason: Fixation duration/count and first fixation differ from normalized allocation; no exact scoped proportion contrast extracted.

hypotheses.question: Learning gain proves attention→load→learning mediation.
hypotheses.reason: Meta-regression across studies is not pathway-specific causal mediation.

hypotheses.question: N-back practice increases general PSY-058 availability.
hypotheses.reason: EA-0011 remains UNKNOWN; practiced/untrained n-back gain differs from broader resources.

hypotheses.question: Higher n-back accuracy is working-memory availability by definition.
hypotheses.reason: Score is a task-dependent indicator, not the construct.

hypotheses.question: Mindfulness changes PSY-062 across tasks.
hypotheses.reason: Active-comparator, accuracy/latency and clinical sampling differences; no single reusable operation or exact transferable capacity identified.

hypotheses.question: Psychological acceptance flexibility equals cognitive flexibility.
hypotheses.reason: Acceptance and perspective/rule switching are different constructs.

hypotheses.question: Disfluent font reliably increases PSY-059 elaboration.
hypotheses.reason: Meyer replication pool found no CRT solution advantage; original heuristic results do not establish exact issue-relevant processing.

hypotheses.question: Longer response times demonstrate deeper elaboration.
hypotheses.reason: Slowness can be decoding difficulty, distraction or strategy.

hypotheses.question: Processing fluency equals familiarity or confidence.
hypotheses.reason: Ease is information interpreted in context, not either judgment.

hypotheses.question: Perceived exclusion changes selective attention to acceptance cues.
hypotheses.reason: Threat, Cyberball and gaze designs differ; no uniform exclusion effect; reuse existing identity only when operation matches.

hypotheses.question: Social inclusion and exclusion are one opposite signed attention effect.
hypotheses.reason: A non-social control can separate inclusion effects from exclusion nondetection.

hypotheses.question: Culture relates to object/context attention allocation.
hypotheses.reason: Country group is not an exact CUL Driver; sampling, language and viewing context confounded. No new ontology entity.

hypotheses.question: Financial scarcity cues reduce available WM.
hypotheses.reason: Task performance is not PSY-058; small/uncertain effects and limited designs in cue meta-analysis; subjective scarcity not income itself.

hypotheses.question: A prime makes the ConstrualFrame LEVEL increase.
hypotheses.reason: PSY-060 is nominal categorical, with no common ordinal increase across frames.

hypotheses.question: Qualified PSY-060 frame changes from a named baseline category to another.
hypotheses.reason: External wording/choice is not proof of internal category transition; exact validated state qualifier and timing needed.

hypotheses.question: Sleep duration changes load rather than performance.
hypotheses.reason: Protected BIO-F01 B04 already owns exact alternatives; no new proposal or prior-pilot repair.

hypotheses.question: Ambient noise changes load.
hypotheses.reason: Existing ENV-045 review only; speech/task and comparator need exact alignment.

hypotheses.question: Physical fatigue→load→participation equality is a transmitted pathway.
hypotheses.reason: PRC-085 reachability and NIMH framework references lack pathway-specific evidence and unit alignment.

hypotheses.question: Need for cognition modifies REL-PSY-029.
hypotheses.reason: Exact capacity×disposition interaction under an aligned message/task not extracted; no substitute trait→outcome edge.

hypotheses.question: Prior knowledge modifies the instructional cue effect.
hypotheses.reason: Schneider meta-analysis did not identify prior knowledge as moderator; between-study comparisons not an exact governed causal-edge interaction.

hypotheses.question: Load and availability are automatically two independent causal contributions.
hypotheses.reason: Complementary resource descriptions can double represent one contribution; independence needs evidence.

hypotheses.question: Cognitive load transforms into stress.
hypotheses.reason: Separate constructs do not become each other; existing causal claim remains independently research-needed.

hypotheses.question: Emotionally intense content causes salience.
hypotheses.reason: Content, relevance, valence and psychological prominence must be separated; preserve external ownership.

hypotheses.question: Network position or screen opportunity directly sets attention.
hypotheses.reason: Opportunity/observed gaze/state delta is not subjective allocation or empirical consequence evidence.

canonicalSourceReviews.finding: Moran2016 DOI10.1037/bul0000051:177samples22061 people, anxiety/WMC association and narrative experimental evidence; task and compensation limits.
Eysenck/Derakshan/Santos/Calvo2007 attentional-control theory: efficiency can decline while compensatory effort preserves effectiveness.
NIMH RDoC definitions framework, not TDF and not empirical support for physiological recovery, load, support or audience effects.
RDoC units-of-analysis not an exact causal study; no physiological/subjective equivalence.
Prior F03 source concern: dehumanization/violence not exact moral-conviction/disgust endpoint; no new causal extraction.
Cane2012 TDF validation not a selective-attention allocation experiment.
Prospect theory is not measurement validation of an internally adopted nominal frame.
Canonical ELM chapter title and stored journal PII remain unresolved; no new exact result attributed to this locator.
Alter/Oppenheimer2009 review of experienced ease and judgment; context/attribution matter, not direct accuracy or calibration.
Diamond2013 executive-functions review distinguishes attention/inhibition, WM and flexibility and their task measures; no exact binary load calculation.
Dajani/Uddin2015 calls for consistent cognitive-flexibility operationalization; imaging/set-switching measures not automatic general capacity.
Need-for-cognition instrument assessment not an intervention changing disposition or proof of an identified trait→state effect.
Koriat2012 combines model/simulation and empirical tasks. Reliability/self-consistency differs from correctness; speed cue validity conditional. Model inference not relabeled empirical.

Named Overcoming intuition paper is Alter/Oppenheimer/Epley/Eyre2007 DOI10.1037/0096-3445.136.4.569. Stored2009 PMID19638628 instead resolves SRC125 review. Original heuristic findings challenged by Meyer2015; no canonical repair.
Same publication as SRC-405, not independent replication. Framed decision wording and chosen response do not measure every internal representation.
Duplicate component of SRC183; one scientific source.
Scientific-misinformation synthesis reference; no newly extracted emotional-intensity→psychological salience contrast.
IPCC health/wellbeing chapter cannot substitute for a specified ambient-noise→occupied-resource study; SRC340 supplies narrower performance literature.
COM-B framework not an ambiguity/load causal experiment; INF-F03 review unchanged.
RDoC behavioral assessment report not proof of exact ambiguity effect; protected INF-F03 proposal reused.
Noise/performance meta-analysis. Provisional0065 retired during whole-register dedup; no new canonical source.
